info.title: Castlane CRM API
info.description: Internal REST API of Castlane CRM. All paths are relative to /api/v1. Session cookie authentication; state-changing requests need the X-CSRF-Token header and a same-origin Origin. Responses use the {data, meta} envelope; errors use {error}.

get.summary: Issue a pre-session CSRF token (double-submit cookie).
Describe an invitation (workspace and e-mail only; closed projects are not revealed).

post.summary: Accept an invitation: new account (display name + password) or existing account (password).
Ask the workspace administrators for a new invitation after expiry.

get.summary: Current user, workspaces and CSRF token.

post.summary: Regenerate recovery codes (recent authentication required). Old codes stop working.
Start TOTP setup (from a setup challenge or a recently authenticated session).
Confirm TOTP setup with a valid code; returns recovery codes once.
Complete sign-in with a TOTP or recovery code.
Change own password; other sessions are revoked.
Confirm password (and TOTP when enabled) for critical actions (recent authentication).
Request a password reset link (response never reveals whether the account exists).
Reset the password with a one-time token; revokes all sessions.

get.summary: List own active sessions.

post.summary: Revoke one of own sessions.
Sign out all other sessions.
Sign in with e-mail and password.
Revoke the current session.
Set the current workspace of the session.
Remove one usage link (the file itself stays).
